indexes.name: idx_agent_connections_one_active
indexes.sql:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_agent_connections_one_active
            ON agent_connections(agent_id)
            WHERE status IN ('pending','connected')

indexes.name: idx_agents_provider_status

indexes.name: idx_attach_room
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_attach_room ON attachments(room_id, id)

indexes.name: idx_audit_task
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_audit_task ON audit(task_id,id)

indexes.name: idx_memver
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_memver ON member_memory_versions(member, scope, key, id DESC)

indexes.name: idx_messages_approval_task
indexes.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_messages_approval_task
           ON messages(task_id,id DESC) WHERE kind='approval_request'

indexes.name: idx_messages_dispatch_decisions
indexes.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_messages_dispatch_decisions
           ON messages(author_id,id) WHERE kind IN ('chat','decision')

indexes.name: idx_pair_attempts_ts
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_pair_attempts_ts ON pair_attempts(ts)

indexes.name: idx_review_log_task_time
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_review_log_task_time ON review_log(task_id,created_at)

indexes.name: idx_runs_one_running
indexes.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_runs_one_running ON runs(task_id) WHERE status='running'

indexes.name: idx_skillver
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_skillver ON skill_versions(skill_id, version DESC)

indexes.name: idx_task_transfers_pending_expiry
indexes.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_task_transfers_pending_expiry
           ON task_transfers(expires_at, id)
           WHERE status='pending' AND expires_at IS NOT NULL

indexes.name: idx_transfers_task
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_transfers_task ON task_transfers(task_id, id)

indexes.name: idx_tasks_active_queue
indexes.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_active_queue
           ON tasks(urgent DESC, id ASC, assignee)
           WHERE status IN ('open','claimed','working')

indexes.name: idx_tasks_assignee_urgent_id
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_assignee_urgent_id ON tasks(assignee, urgent DESC, id ASC)

indexes.name: idx_tasks_lease_expiry
indexes.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_lease_expiry
           ON tasks(lease_expires)
           WHERE status IN ('claimed','working') AND lease_expires IS NOT NULL

indexes.name: idx_tasks_room_urgent_id
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_room_urgent_id ON tasks(room_id, urgent DESC, id ASC)

indexes.name: idx_tasks_unclaimed_due
indexes.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_unclaimed_due
           ON tasks(assignee, next_claim_at)
           WHERE status='open' AND assignee IS NOT NULL

indexes.name: idx_tasks_urgent_id
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_urgent_id ON tasks(urgent DESC, id ASC)
